description: The MCP alert card window (`alert`), which `main.rs` builds on the first alert. It renders text an MCP server controls, so it gets its own capability with only what the card needs rather than sharing `default` with the HUD. `core:event:allow-listen` and `core:event:allow-unlisten` let it receive uia://mcp-alert; `take_pending_alerts` and `dismiss_alert` are app commands and need no ACL entry. `core:window:allow-set-size` lets the page shrink the window to the height of its stacked cards with `getCurrentWindow().setSize()`, so the transparent, always-on-top window does not swallow clicks below them. `core:window:allow-get-all-windows` is what `WebviewWindow.getByLabel('hud')` calls, and `core:window:allow-show`, `core:window:allow-unminimize` and `core:window:allow-set-focus` let a click on a card's body bring the `hud` window back from hidden or minimised and focus it. `opener:allow-open-url`, scoped here to `https://*` only, opens a card's action link in the default browser; the parser already drops any non-https action, and this keeps the window from opening anything else even if that changed. Showing and hiding the `alert` window itself is done in Rust and needs no grant.
